staged_protocol.stage_1: Download and inspect only NCML, FGDC XML, reports, and official file inventory.
staged_protocol.stage_2_condition: Before any response payload download, metadata must prove coordinates, line identity, transmitter geometry and current, exact waveform, gate times, response components, and per-observation uncertainty semantics.
staged_protocol.stage_2_role_rule: If the condition passes, freeze a coordinate-first spatial split and verify its correlation-adjusted test-cluster upper bound before opening response arrays.
staged_protocol.abort_condition: Do not download response payloads when the metadata contract fails or the response-blind spatial design cannot possibly provide 223 effective test clusters.
